awards.title: First Place — Sistecredito’s Third Hackathon
awards.summary: Won first place at Sistecredito’s third hackathon.
awards.details:
We won first place at Sistecredito’s third Hackathon with EIA University by building a smart product management solution for retailers.
The system predicts product demand with LSTM models and includes a NestJS + MongoDB backend (deployed on AWS) and a Next.js frontend (on Vercel).
It helps retailers keep optimal stock levels and introduces the vision of automated, proactive ordering.

awards.title: First Place — Sistecredito’s Second Hackathon
awards.summary: Won first place at Sistecredito’s second hackathon.
awards.details:
We won first place at a Sistecredito hackathon by designing a fraud-detection system for 1.7M labeled transactions.
Our approach proposed a multi-model architecture tailored to individual spending habits, favoring unsupervised methods due to data imbalance and real-world constraints.
Although key data insights limited full implementation, we delivered strong analysis and a supervised model to demonstrate the solution.

awards.title: First Place — ISA Intercolombia’s Hackathon
awards.summary: Won first place at ISA Intercolombia’s hackathon.
awards.details:
We tackled ISA’s unpredictable powerline failures by reframing the problem as a logistics and optimization challenge.
Our concept predicted failure risks, optimized service center locations, routing, and stock allocation using data-driven models.
Though limited by hackathon constraints, the solution showed how predictive analytics could transform infrastructure maintenance.
